query:
SELECT
                        id,
                        name,
                        description,
                        status::text  AS "status!",
                        deadline,
                        goal_id,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                    FROM projects
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND (name ILIKE $2 OR description ILIKE $2)
                    ORDER BY
                        (name ILIKE $3) DESC,
                        updated_at DESC
                    LIMIT $4
